latest_v4_local_screens: At PB-01 the tested full-section overlap loses two fixed service-rail screw receivers and its trial bolt bore/head washer/tool conflict with one protected center-panel screw under conditional purchased-Hillman envelopes. The grain-N 4x6 cleat clears the tested local solids and all 66 such envelopes but its 3/8-in centered tangent edge is 28.575 mm, 9.525 mm short of a conditional 4D loaded-edge screen; two 4D edges cannot fit under the current straight-tool allowance. At PB-02 a 37.8-mm outward move of only the right center post plus a nominal 4x6 backer supports both inner kicker edges and all 18 full-length purchased kicker screw paths; its three-wood-member through-bolt pose has no strength result, and the shifted post has only 0.30 mm projected overlap with the upright above, not a viable load-transfer detail. These are conditional geometry diagnostics, not G1 or drilling release.
latest_pb01_hybrid_and_quarter_screen: A 1/4-in four-bolt 4x6 cleat pose has positive conditional 7D/4D placement margins and no modeled bore, washer, tool, neighboring-solid or 66 fixed-axis clash. The 2024 NDS supplies conditional 45-ksi bolt-class bending yield and a typical 0.189-in root; delivered root/thread placement, load categories, group and complete joint checks remain open. All are old-topology sensitivities, not V4 same-case demands. See simple-pb01-hybrid-native-sensitivity.md, simple-pb01-quarter-yield-screen.md and simple-pb01-quarter-member-screen.md; no six-case new-topology response or drilling release exists.

latest_center_screens: The active V4 right-center-post trial moves only that post outward 37.8 mm, retains the separate kicker backer, and adds two rectangular wood cleats with four ordinary trial through-bolt axes toward the unchanged upright. Its nominal CAD probe confirms timber contact, complete intended bore wood, all 66 fixed panel/kicker screw-axis clearances and both inner kicker edge supports. It also records clashes with the two historical right-center clip bodies and ten modeled clip fasteners: those old stations cannot remain and their duties must be replaced. It is not a qualified connection: a link center is 16.65 mm and post-bolt centers 18.85 mm from possible loaded X edges versus conditional 38.1-mm 4D for 3/8-in; one upright end margin is only 0.825 mm against a hypothetical 7D; front post-head access is blocked by the installed kicker. See simple-center-post-transfer.md. Historical HL33 tongue and thick-rail poses remain geometry evidence only. No G1 or drilling release.
latest_rail_relief_screen: Profiled one-piece 4x6 bottom rails remove only added rear wood around header and upper seats; nominal CAD clashes clear and full-thickness rail-side bands remain. No factory bracket or mating seat, bolt group, access or resistance is established. The shared-post stack screen rejects 8-in nominal length with two washers and full nut; longer A307-listed dimensional leads lack explicit Grade A subtype. Both are conditional development evidence, not G1 closure. See hardware_first_center_rail_relief.md and hardware_first_center_post_stack.md.
latest_upper_pair_and_rail_bracket_scree: The same-Y opposing upper HL33 pair is rejected by seat-seat overlap and opposite-principal penetration. Outward translation of unchanged rectangular principals sufficient to separate seats loses fixed center panel screw axes. A bounded exact-retail A66/HL33/UB66 rail bracket shortlist finds no demonstrated all-six installed fit and ordinary-duration resistance. This does not reject every alternative factory-bracket pose. See hardware_first_center_upper_pair.md and rail-factory-bracket-shortlist.md.
latest_upper_stagger_screen: Rearward shifts of both inward upper HL33 brackets by 63.5, 66 and 70 mm retain seat-seat and opposite-principal collisions and lose bore receiving wood at the oblique toes. These sampled poses are rejected; no continuous search or all-bracket verdict. See hardware_first_center_upper_stagger.md.
latest_load_axis_screen: Corrected against Simpson C-C-2026 p.315 typical installation: HL F1 follows horizontal flange reach, perpendicular to the bend. For outward-X HL33, local F1 maps to global X; global Y is the unlisted transverse action. The prior Y/F1 mapping was rotated by 90 degrees. Paired HLs do not create unlisted Y or moment capacity. MiTek B66 publishes F2 but only at C_D=1.6. Current-geometry simultaneous demand and ordinary-duration resistance remain unresolved. See hl-load-axis-audit.md and hl_load_axes.py.
latest_hl_connected_screens: Two 45/65-mm rear-extension HL33 common-core poses preserve all 66 screw receivers and disjoint wood solids but reject: the shared backing bolt crosses only 50.8 mm of core tongue against the 88.9-mm catalog minimum, uses an unlisted three-wood/two-angle stack, and has blocked bolt-end/tool access; all six rail connections remain open. HL53 separated-rib poses at 480/520/560-mm spacing reject bracket-body/neighbor conflicts; a 520-mm bottom-right rail probe has only 49.904 mm local wood at two seat bolts, bores leave the rail, and tool access meets a panel. These are pose failures, not family verdicts. See hardware_first_hl33_common_core.md and hardware_first_hl53_spaced_ribs.md.
latest_hl_revisions: The independent-bolt HL33 backing revision removes the shared three-wood stack and meets nominal 88.9-mm receiving thickness but still rejects on nut/tool blockage and an unverified one-piece blank; six rail connections remain open. HL53 wide-rib 620/660-mm cases clear sampled header-link clashes; 700 mm hits a protected screw. At 660 mm, one bottom-right rail HL53 with 15-mm gap has 15 mm unsupported seat; a zero-gap probe has full nominal seat contact, four contained bores and all 66 screw receivers. Its subsequent parent-neighbor screen clears modeled clashes with surrounding wood and eight header links, but actual hardware, five other rail joints and resistance remain open. A sampled 125.868-mm square cross-section fits a listed Lowe's 6x6 Douglas-fir blank dimensionally, not as delivered/accepted stock. See hardware_first_hl33_backing_revision.md, hardware_first_hl53_wide_ribs.md, hardware_first_hl53_660_parent_neighbor.md and hl-action-coverage-preliminary.md. No architecture selected, rated joint, or drilling release.
latest_hl_resistance_source_screen: Simpson's current HL row gives 7-gauge nominal product geometry and (160) uplift/F1 values, but no exact HL steel grade/yield/minimum base thickness, governing mode, (100) values, transverse F2 or moment resistance. No manufacturer inquiry is authorized or made. See hl-formed-steel-source-limit.md and hl-ordinary-duration-decision.md.
latest_b66_component_route: MiTek's exact retail UB66/B66 mapping, official DXF and ESR-3455 provide ASTM A653 SS Grade 40 steel, 0.099-in minimum base thickness, four 3/8-in A307 Grade A-or-better bolts and a 3-in wood minimum. One 660-mm zero-gap bottom-right rail pose rejects because its complete first upright wood bore exits the rib by 1869.507 mm3, although its centerline meets thickness. Two bounded corrections, moving the bracket 6 mm forward or extending the one-piece rib profile 6 mm rearward, each clear nominal full-bore/parent-neighbor screens without losing the fixed screw receivers. They are local geometry leads, not a completed connection; five rail ends and complete hardware remain open. ESR Table 3 F1/F2 loads are only at C_D=1.6 and cannot be adjusted to normal duration; independent complete wood/bolt/formed-steel/contact analysis remains required. See hardware_first_b66_660_component_route.md and hardware_first_b66_660_rib_repair.md.
latest_br904_drawing_screen: Lowe's exact-model Adamax BR904 listing links a dimensioned image with rounded nominal width, leg lengths, thickness, hole diameters and hole centers. latest_rear_and_raised_center_screens: One rear-Y B66 center arrangement and three drawing-based BR904 raised-seat rows are rejected on nominal installed geometry. The B66 upper bores leave sloping principal wood and changed members intersect adjacent wood. The BR904 lower-post bore modeling error was corrected; the three actual rejections are inward-seat/principal interference and conservative wood edge/end search margins. Both screens preserve all 66 panel/kicker screw receivers. Neither tests all possible factory-bracket poses or establishes resistance. See hardware_first_b66_rear_y.md and hardware_first_br904_raised_seat.md.
latest_outward_and_front_center_screens: The drawing-based outward BR904 upper seats clear nominal plate, bolt-path, panel and screw collisions, but two principal rows miss the conservative reversible 4D-plus-hole-play edge marker by up to 43.650 mm; the lower post and rail connections are outside this one-pose study. See hardware_first_br904_outward_seat.md and hardware_first_b66_front_y.md.
latest_deep_principal_upper_screen: A one-piece 60-mm rearward deepening of each principal clears nominal upper outward BR904 plate, bore, panel, screw and adjacent-member contacts while retaining all 66 screw receivers. The principal edge and header shoulder search reserves are only +2.313/+2.361 mm; these are neither tolerance-qualified nor formal NDS acceptance. A live Home Depot 4x10x12 #2 Premium Fir listing contains the sampled blank envelope dimensionally, but the listed 3.5-in thickness matches CAD exactly with no machining allowance, and local stock, delivered grade/species, yield and dimensions remain unverified. The lower center and six rail joints are absent. See hardware_first_br904_deep_principal.md.
latest_br904_reserve_screen: A follow-up 80-mm one-piece principal deepening and 242-mm raised-header half-width give nominal +17.634-mm principal transverse and +14.361-mm header shoulder search reserves, while the oblique-toe ray marker remains only +2.834 mm. No tolerance, complete center joint, or bolted-wood BR904 rating is established; preserve this as historical geometry evidence rather than active G1 selection. See hardware_first_br904_reserve.md.
